warning options_missing_custom_element 1:17-1:45 The `customElement` option is used when generating a custom element. Did you forget the `customElement: true` compile option?
    https://svelte.dev/e/options_missing_custom_element
warning custom_element_props_identifier 4:6-4:11 Using a rest element or a non-destructured declaration with `$props()` means that Svelte can't infer what properties to expose when creating a custom element. Consider destructuring all the props or explicitly specifying the `customElement.props` option.
    https://svelte.dev/e/custom_element_props_identifier
